headline: Shmyhal says Ukraine is ahead of schedule in preparing for winter in terms of gas reserves — DSnews.ua
summary: Ukraine's Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal said the country has accumulated 14.3 billion cubic metres of natural gas in underground storage. He said the filling pace is ahead of schedule for winter.
why: Gas storage levels indicate how well a country is prepared for winter demand and its exposure to gas supply and price shocks.
